context.body: The cross in four witnesses · Luke 23:26–43
context.label: Canonical location

observations.body: Simon carries behind Jesus; a crowd and mourning women follow; rulers, soldiers, and criminals then speak at the cross.
observations.label: Simon, mourning women, forgiveness, and two criminals: textual observation

observations.body: Jesus addresses daughters of Jerusalem, asks forgiveness, receives mockery, and answers one criminal.
observations.label: Simon, mourning women, forgiveness, and two criminals: action, promise, or consequence

observations.body: Luke distinguishes the two criminals rather than leaving their speech collective.
observations.label: Relationships named in Luke 23:26–43

payload.posture: Read Luke 23:26–43 as its own the cross in four witnesses crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: Mockery and appeal occur beside each other, and Jesus answers only the second criminal in the supplied sequence.
payload.title: Simon, mourning women, forgiveness, and two criminals
